artwork.name: BODEGA
artwork.description: Cold drinks, crowded shelves, and a counter that hears everything. This corner stays open long after the rest of the block calls it a night.

artwork.name: THE TRAP
artwork.description: Low lights spill through boarded windows while the bass carries down the alley. Every doorway has a lookout, and every arrival gets noticed.

artwork.name: WAFF-L HOUSE
artwork.description: The griddle never cools and the coffee never quits. After midnight, this booth-lined diner turns into the block’s unofficial meeting room.

artwork.name: VIP SECTION
artwork.description: Past the velvet rope, the lights get softer and the jewelry gets louder. The whole room watches who gets a seat.

artwork.name: COUNTY JAIL
artwork.description: Steel doors, hard benches, and fluorescent lights that never sleep. Every sound travels down the corridor.

artwork.name: PENTHOUSE
artwork.description: High above the street noise, the windows frame a city that never settles down. The elevator opens straight into the afterparty.

artwork.name: TIME SQUARE
artwork.description: Towering signs paint the pavement in electric color. Tourists, hustlers, and late-night crews all cross paths under the same glow.

artwork.name: MAGIC CITY
artwork.description: Pink neon cuts through the haze while the speakers keep the room moving. The night gets louder every time another crew walks in.

artwork.name: THE SUBWAY
artwork.description: Train brakes scream beneath the city and warm air rolls across the platform. Everybody is waiting for their next stop.

artwork.name: O-BLOCK
artwork.description: Apartment windows overlook a corner that remembers every face. The sidewalks belong to the people who show up for each other.

artwork.name: HOLLYWOOD STRIP
artwork.description: Marquee lights and camera flashes turn the sidewalk into a stage. Around here, making an entrance is part of the job.

artwork.name: DIVE BAR
artwork.description: Faded signs, sticky floors, and a jukebox with a long memory. The regulars know which stool belongs to who.

artwork.name: ACORN PROJECTS
artwork.description: Concrete walkways connect the buildings, and every balcony has a view of the courtyard. Word travels fast between these doors.

artwork.name: CORRUPT CHURCH
artwork.description: Colored light falls across old pews while quiet deals happen behind the pulpit. Even the collection plate has a story.

artwork.name: NAIL SALON
artwork.description: Glossy polish, bright mirrors, and conversations that carry across every station. Fresh nails leave with fresher neighborhood news.

artwork.name: BARBERSHOP
artwork.description: Clippers buzz under the striped pole while the chairs fill with familiar faces. A fresh cut comes with a full report from the block.

artwork.name: UNDERGROUND RING
artwork.description: Bare bulbs hang above the ropes and the crowd presses close to the canvas. Down here, every hit echoes through the concrete.

artwork.name: ROOFTOP GARDEN
artwork.description: Green leaves climb above the brick and satellite dishes. Up on this roof, the city sounds a little farther away.

artwork.name: PAWN SHOP
artwork.description: Gold chains, old speakers, and somebody’s favorite things crowd the glass cases. Every price tag hides a story.

artwork.name: PIRATE RADIO
artwork.description: A homemade antenna reaches over the rooftops while a hidden booth keeps the speakers alive. This signal belongs to the streets.

artwork.name: BLACKOUT BLOCK
artwork.description: The streetlights are out and the windows have gone quiet. Footsteps and distant sirens fill the space the neon left behind.

artwork.name: FLOOD CHANNEL
artwork.description: Rainwater races between concrete walls beneath the bridges. Even on a clear night, this stretch of the city feels restless.

artwork.name: CONSTRUCTION SITE
artwork.description: Steel beams, warning tape, and unfinished floors cut into the skyline. Beyond the fence, the city is still taking shape.

artwork.name: NIGHT MARKET
artwork.description: Lanterns swing above packed stalls and steam rises between the crowds. The best finds come after the rest of the city closes up.

artwork.name: MIRROR ARCADE
artwork.description: Cabinet screens flicker across mirrored walls while tokens rattle in the trays. Every corner glows like another high score waiting to happen.

artwork.name: COMMUNITY KITCHEN
artwork.description: Big pots simmer behind the serving counter and nobody leaves hungry. The whole block has a place at this table.

artwork.name: RUSH HOUR
artwork.description: Headlights stack up beneath the signals while horns bounce between the buildings. Everybody has somewhere to be, all at once.

artwork.name: THE TOWN
artwork.description: Familiar corners and warm windows stretch across the neighborhood. Every block has a story, and somebody here knows yours.

artwork.name: GROUP CHAT
artwork.description: The messages keep flying and the whole crew stays tapped in. News hits this chat before it makes it down the street.

artwork.name: SERVER ROOM
artwork.description: Rows of hardware hum beneath a cold electric glow. Behind these doors, the neighborhood’s noise becomes a signal.
